questions.text:
Question 8. 
 
Which of these values can replace <value> in the code segment 
shown on the right and cause the output to be "Option 1"? 
I. 30     II. 14     III. 33     IV. 53     V. 54 
A) I, II, III and V 
 
B) II and III  
C) III and IV  
D) I, II and V  
E) II and V 
int x = <value>; 
if(x < 30 || x % 2 == 0) 
out.print("Option 1"); 
else  
out.print("Option 2");
questions.explanation:
x < 30 || x % 2 == 0 evaluates as true whenever x is less than 30 or an even number. 
30 and 54 are both even and 14 is less than 30 and even.
